newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Mubarak to meet Libyan leader on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak to meet Libyan leader on Monday.

text.p: The Egyptian President will meet Libyan leader Colonel Muammar Gaddafi on Monday, an official source said on Sunday.
They said Mubarak would fly to the Egyptian military base of Sidi Barrani, about 80 km (50 miles) from the border with Libya.

Mubarak would either hold talks with Gaddafi for a few hours at the base or travel by land to the Libyan town of Tobruk, which is also close to the border, the source who refused to be named said. A U.N. embargo bans air travel to or from Libya.
"A meeting between the two leaders will take place, but we're not sure where," he said.
Mubarak is currently holding talks in Cairo with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on the Middle East peace process.
